name: Hotel Colosseo
description: A stunning 4-star hotel themed around ancient Rome and Italy. Guests are immersed in Roman architecture with dramatic columns, mosaics and fountains. Located steps from the park entrance.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room with Roman-themed decor, twin or double beds, and modern amenities.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger room with upgraded furnishings, seating area and views over the hotel grounds.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area, premium Roman decor and priority park entry.

name: Hotel Bell Rock
description: A 4-star hotel inspired by the New England coastline and Cape Cod architecture. Bright airy rooms with nautical touches, a large pool and direct access to the park.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Cheerful New England styled room with twin or double beds and garden or pool views.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Larger room sleeping up to 2 adults and 2 children with bunk beds and playful decor.

rooms.name: Lighthouse Suite
rooms.description: Premium suite with panoramic views, sitting room and exclusive lounge access.

name: Hotel El Andaluz
description: A beautiful 4-star hotel inspired by southern Spain and Andalusian architecture. White-washed walls, terracotta tiles and lush courtyard gardens create an authentic Mediterranean escape.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant Andalusian-styled room with warm tones, tiled floors and courtyard or garden views.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger room with upgraded furnishings, balcony and views over the courtyard fountain.

rooms.name: Patio Suite
rooms.description: Generous suite with private patio, sitting area and premium Spanish decor throughout.
